sources.snippet: Instead of clustering-based quantization, we use fixed random projection for its simplicity and effectiveness. We also implement a generalized noisy speech augmentation that teaches the model to disentangle the main speaker from noise or other speakers.

sources.snippet: Researchers from NVIDIA have introduced a new solution, the NeMo Encoder for Speech Tasks (NEST), which addresses these challenges. NEST is built on the FastConformer architecture, offering an efficient and simplified framework for self-supervised learning in speech processing.
